messages:
incident-bot: PROD ALERT: routing-service (smart-routing) elevated error rate ~12% and long tail latencies originating in eu-central-1. Possible cross-region retry loop detected. Auto-page to #incidents and oncall. :rotating_light:
jamie: I'm oncall — paging SRE (sarah) and runtime infra (kevin). Anyone seeing customer reports?
sarah: grabbing logs and flame graphs. I can see repeating pattern of 'fallback_select' -> 'route_decision: us-west-2' -> 'compatibility_reject' -> 'route_decision: eu-central-1' every ~3s per request id.
kevin: We pushed schema-v2 migration earlier at 05:20Z. There were warnings about deprecated property handling (`preferred_model_variant`). Did the migration sanitize empty values?
priya: Migration notes: we normalized to new `variant_preferences` array. If `preferred_model_variant` was present but empty string, the migration inadvertently dropped the key entirely instead of translating to empty array. The router assumes missing = default_auto which triggers global fallback behavior.
jamie: That sounds like a config gap. What's the immediate customer impact?
lina-cs: CS reports three impacted paying customers on policy p-7782; endpoints experiencing timeouts and degraded outputs. Two support tickets opened. I'll prepare comms once we have a mitigation.
sarah: Reproduced pattern with a synthetic request: sequence -> pick eu variant v2 -> incompatibility (quantization mismatch) -> global fallback G_vsmall chosen -> routing policy then picks region based on proximity, sending to us-west-2 -> there G_vsmall incompatible with hardware -> fallback picks regional default -> back to eu. TTL loop until request abort. Confirmed on staging.
kevin: Root cause = migration removed explicit variant_preferences for some legacy policies. Router default fallback code chooses a non-regional global fallback id when compatibility fails. That global id is not universally compatible, so it triggers region re-evaluation -> loop.
jamie: Mitigation options? Fastest is to disable auto fallback in prod or lock affected policies to a region. Also could restore the deprecated field from pre-migration snapshot.
priya: We have a snapshot db dump at 05:15Z. I can restore the affected policy documents to their pre-migration state.
sarah: I'm in favor of a quick flag flip to cut off the automatic fallback mechanism first. We minimize customer impact by preventing region oscillation. Command to flip flag (ops-bot):
```bash
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"flag":"smart_routing.enable_auto_global_fallback","value":false,"env":"prod"}' https://flags.internal/api
```
kevin: I'll apply a region_lock for the highest-impact policy p-7782 while priya restores configs. Command: `redwoodctl policy update p-7782 --set region_lock=eu-central-1`
jamie: Sarah go ahead and flip the flag. Kevin lock region. Priya start restores off snapshot. Lina prep CS notice.
sarah: Applied flag toggle at 05:32Z. Response: {"status":"ok","flag":"smart_routing.enable_auto_global_fallback","value":false}. Monitoring...
kevin: region_lock applied to p-7782 at 05:34Z. CLI returned success.
priya: Restoring policies from snapshot now (05:35Z). Restored 5 policies that lost `preferred_model_variant`. Confirming fields present.
sarah: After flag flip we see fallback traces stop. Error rate dropped from 12% -> 3% within 45s, latency p95 improved. No new paging.
lina-cs: Sent targeted note to affected customers: "We detected routing configuration issue impacting model selection for some requests between 05:20-05:40 UTC. Engineers applied mitigations and are restoring configurations. We'll share an RCA when available." Customers acknowledged — two asked for ETA for full fix.
kevin: I pushed a temporary hotfix to routing-service config that treats missing `variant_preferences` as an empty list rather than default_auto, preventing global fallback choose. Deployed to prod in canary (one instance) at 05:40Z. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/routing/+/1240
jamie: Good. Keep the feature-flag off until we have a verified patch in prod. Priya, confirm restored policies have `preferred_model_variant` set and that migration script will be updated.
priya: Confirmed: restored policies now include preferred model variant values. I'll open PR to make migration idempotent and to add explicit migration tests to catch empty-string -> dropped-key scenarios.
sarah: Metrics now stable: aggregated 5xx ~0.7%, p95 latency back to baseline. No new errors in the replayed traces.
kevin: Quick post-mortem notes: 1) migration sanitized deprecated fields incorrectly; 2) router default fallback path assumed global fallback always compatible; 3) combined these to create cross-region flip flop.
jamie: Action items and owners:
 - priya: migration fix + tests + deploy plan (owner)
 - sarah: add synthetic monitor to detect repeated region flip patterns (owner)
 - kevin: follow-up patch to make global fallback selection conservative (owner)
 - lina-cs: customer follow-ups and timelines (owner)
 - ops-bot: keep incident flag audit record

lina-cs: I'll send updated timeline and promised ETA for RCA by EOD.
priya: PRs opened: migration-fix (#230) and schema-validation (#231). Plan to deploy migration-fix tomorrow in maintenance window and schema validation immediately to block new bad writes.
sarah: I'll add an alert rule to catch more than 3 region switches per request_id within 60s.
jamie: Thanks team. Keeping this thread open for 2 hours for monitoring. If all stable, we'll close and produce RCA doc. :thumbsup:
